LanguageData.DMSL_Settings_EnableDrillingBargeExperim: Enable experimental drilling barge work logic

Enable this option if the drilling barge causes long freezes when searching for mineable minerals. It replaces the barge's search logic with a gentler, incremental scan.\n\nNote: Enabling this adds ongoing performance cost and longer delay before new veins are assigned. Do not enable unless you experience noticeable stutter.

LanguageData.DMSL_AerialRaidPagerIntro_LetterText: As your colony grows, more factions begin to pay attention, and pirates naturally want their share. Pirate raiding parties carrying air support pagers may visit your colony. An air support pager is a portable device used to call aerial support. Pirates use it to call bombing runs to weaken your colony before launching their assault. After pirates arrive, the raider carrying the pager will first attempt to transmit bombing coordinates. If you can interrupt this process, you can prevent the follow-up bombing. If bombers are already airborne, you can fire Electronic Decoy Shells from mortars to interfere with target selection. If your colony can deploy AXF-12 fighters, you may also intercept them directly. If you provoke the Armed Colonial Fleet, they may also dispatch bomber formations against your colony. Maybe we can handle that the same way?
LanguageData.DMSL_ArmyAllyIntro_LetterLabel: Message from the Armed Colonial Fleet
LanguageData.DMSL_ArmyAllyIntro_LetterText:
As your colony has entered an alliance with the Armed Colonial Fleet, Fleet Command issues the following notice:

Bombers called by air support pagers belong to the Ancient Main Battle Division. Their combat protocols still accept top-level command directives from the Fleet, and they can be ordered to return.

If pirates illegally call ground bombardment via spoofed signals, the Fleet can send a recall command once confirmed, terminating the bomber formation's current attack cycle.

If needed, request intervention via the comms console.

LanguageData.DMSL_AerialRaid_Warning_Text:
Air defense radar has picked up anomalous signals during long-range sweep.

A bomber formation belonging to the Armed Colonial Fleet is approaching this region. Flight trajectory indicates a ground strike mission.

Hostile aircraft are expected to enter effective attack range shortly. Without interference, their ordnance will fall directly on colony-controlled territory.

You may order fighters to intercept incoming targets, or deploy electronic decoys to force the enemy to change bombing coordinates.

Time is limited. Take countermeasures as soon as possible.
